reviews.author: heon jae
reviews.text:
The closest movie theater that showed the movie I wanted was Megabox Dongdaemun, so I visited for the first time and it was pretty good, but the pros and cons are clear.
I think this post will be long, so I'll explain briefly:
Pros: Convenient public transportation
Cons: The building itself is very old and there are very few restaurants in the building.

They say they screen a lot of animations and often held animation previews in the past.
When I came out after watching the movie, there were a lot of anime posters in the hallway.

The museum I visited was theater 3, and because it was lunch time on a weekday, there weren't many people there.
It was nice that the distance from the front seat wasn't wide and the third section itself was quite large.

I was hungry after the movie, so I ate at the steamed chicken restaurant on the same floor and had a delicious Vera dessert.
There were too many closed stores and the downstairs was closed, so all the lights were off and the escalators were blocked. The atmosphere was a bit gloomy.
All the restaurants were closed except for the steamed chicken restaurant.

It rained so heavily that day that we used a restaurant inside the shopping mall, but I think it would be better to eat at a restaurant outside the building if possible.

Our car is a mid-size sedan, and the entrance and exit were very narrow, so we had a bit of trouble. There weren't many parking spaces on each floor, so going down and up was a task.
If you watch a movie, it is free for 3 hours, but you must get a parking ticket from the staff before watching the movie.
The staff initially stamped the receipt and gave it to us, but it turned out that they didn't give us a parking ticket🤔

reviews.author: Byung-Hoon Lee (Cool Guy)
reviews.text:
Lotte Asset Development renewed and opened Lotte Fitin Dongdaemun branch as ‘Dundun Dongdaemun branch’.

Dun Dun Dongdaemun branch is a new store that has been opened by transforming the existing Dongdaemun Fit-In into an experiential cultural complex. It has a store area of ​​about 16,000㎡ (approximately 4,840 pyeong) from the 3rd floor underground to the 8th floor above ground.

The Dun Dun Dongdaemun branch was designed with a concept that foreign tourists and the MZ generation can enjoy in line with the characteristics of the Dongdaemun commercial district, which is reviving.

The name of the store, ‘Dun Dun’, is also an onomatopoeia similar to ‘Dudung’, which is used to emphasize dramatic and tense moments, and carries the meaning of a new space to be opened through the recovery of the Dongdaemun commercial district and future coexistence.

Dun Dun Dongdaemun branch strived to differentiate itself from nearby stores by focusing on famous flagship stores rather than small stores and mid- to low-priced brands.

To this end, we will apply Lotte Department Store's MD know-how and aim for synergy effects by opening Lotte affiliates such as Uniqlo, Lotte Hi-Mart, and 7-Eleven.

In particular, 7-Eleven is attracting attention by opening a specialized store featuring fashion and beauty products. In collaboration with streetwear brand ‘MWOONG’, we sell easy-wear products such as sweatshirts and hoodies that can be worn comfortably.

Popular SPA brands such as Uniqlo, 8 Seconds, and Misso are gathered on the first and second floors of Dun Dun Dongdaemun branch.

On the 3rd floor, ‘Daiso’, the largest in Dongdaemun (1,800㎡, approximately 544 pyeong), is introduced.
Daiso was the store that had the most demand during customer interviews related to the renewal plan.

In addition, the luxury second-hand brand ‘Viva Trade’, the family restaurant ‘Ashley Queens’ in the restaurant area, and the Seongsu-dong hot place ‘Yeonmujang Pub & Cafe’ will be opened.

reviews.author: Hong Yeong-gu
reviews.text: It is right in front of Exit 14 of Dongdaemun History and Culture Stadium Station, so it is easily accessible by public transportation. I attended a national debate on peaceful unification hosted by a civic group over the weekend. The lower floors were a department store-style shopping mall, and the 8th floor was used for events as a banquet hall, seminar, and startup space. Approximately 150 people selected by age and gender attended, listened to a lecture on peaceful unification, answered questions, and had time to present their opinions through group discussions. I attended out of simple interest, but it was a good experience to hear the opinions of ordinary people honestly. When I came out in the evening, the area around DDP was during a festival hosted by the Seoul Metropolitan Government, so many people gathered and there was a lot to see. I hope that more people will come and activate it as an open space, revitalizing the commercial district and making Seoul a wonderful space.

reviews.text:
KANGOL is a global fashion brand best known for its iconic hats and headwear, recognized for blending classic heritage with contemporary street style. With a strong presence in music, street culture, and fashion, the brand offers versatile items that easily elevate everyday outfits.
KANGOLは、アイコニックなハットやキャップで知られるグローバルファッションブランドです。クラシックなヘリテージと現代的なストリートスタイルを融合し、音楽やカルチャーシーンとも深く結びついたデザインが特徴です。
KANGOL是以标志性帽饰闻名的国际时尚品牌，将经典传承与现代街头风格相结合，在音乐、街头文化与时尚领域中拥有广泛影响力。

At Hyundai City Outlet Dongdaemun, you can explore KANGOL alongside a variety of fashion brands, sports stores, and cafés, making it an easy stop for travelers looking for stylish accessories and Korean lifestyle shopping.
現代シティアウトレット東大門では、KANGOLをはじめ、ファッションブランドやスポーツショップ、カフェを一度に楽しめ、コーディネートのアクセントになるアイテム探しにも最適です。
在现代城奥特莱斯东大门店，您可以选购KANGOL，同时体验多样的时尚品牌、运动商店与咖啡馆，轻松挑选适合日常与旅行穿搭的配饰。
